description: This file defines a mock class for the IGstGenericPlayerClient interface used in testing the Rialto server's media playback components. It includes mock methods for various playback and media state notifications.

classes.name: GstGenericPlayerClientMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGstGenericPlayerClient interface for testing purposes.

methods.name: notifyPlaybackState
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of playback state changes.

methods.name: notifyNeedMediaData
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of media data requirements.

methods.name: notifyPosition
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of playback position updates.

methods.name: notifyNetworkState
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of network state changes.

methods.name: clearActiveRequestsCache
methods.description: Mock method to simulate clearing of active requests cache.

methods.name: invalidateActiveRequests
methods.description: Mock method to simulate invalidation of active media requests.

methods.name: notifyQos
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of QoS information.

methods.name: notifyBufferUnderflow
methods.description: Mock method to simulate notification of buffer underflow events.
